# Vendor Questionnaire: PayRail Inc.

## 1. Vendor Profile
PayRail Inc. is a licensed payment processor headquartered in Toronto providing cross-border payout services. PayRail acts as the third-party processor for beneficiary payout and currency conversion.

## 2. Service Coverage
Coverage for this engagement includes Canada, Mexico and Brazil. Brazil payouts are available on request through our local partner network.

## 3. Compliance Program
PayRail has excellent AML controls and a mature compliance program. Sanctions screening of beneficiaries is performed by PayRail prior to payout. Real-time monitoring of payout activity is performed by PayRail on the Bank's behalf.

## 4. Subcontractors
Local payout in Brazil is performed by a partner network of regional payout agents. Screening for partner-network payouts is performed by the partner.

## 5. Volumes
PayRail can support up to 500,000 payouts per month for this program.
